messages.守備で「ランプ」を8にして敵に「眩惑」を付け、眩惑のある敵をS3「灯りに眩惑され: A Sinking and Burn Identity that uses defense to reach 8 Lamp, applies Dazzle, then attacks dazzled enemies with S3 Salvation for those Enchanted by the Lamp. His greatest strength is repeatedly maintaining Dazzle on a boss in Focused Encounters for both increased damage taken and skill enhancements. Requires a team that sustains Burn or Sinking.
messages.ランプから眩惑へ: ランプは最大8。ターン開始時に1を得るほか、「灯りのような眼: **From Lamp to Dazzle**: Lamp has a maximum of 8. Besides gaining 1 at Turn Start, he gains 1 per 2 Gloom Resonance through Eyes Bright Like Lamps (up to 3), and at Combat Start, the Defense skill The Wick of Burned Feathers fills it up to 8 (self-damage equal to 1% of max HP per point gained; HP does not drop below 1). If it is at maximum at Turn End, he spends all of it; next turn his leftmost slot gains 10 Aggro, and the enemy (main body) with the highest current HP receives 3 Dazzle. He gains 1 Bind next turn per 2 Lamp, up to 4.
messages.眩惑: 沈潜と火傷の合計1につき、基本攻撃スキルによる被ダメージ量+0.5%(最: **Dazzle**: +0.5% damage taken from basic attack skills per combined Sinking and Burn, up to 10%. Enemies with SP have their Panic Type changed to Dazzle, and enemies without SP get −2 Defense Level. It decreases by 1 at Turn End (it refreshes rather than stacks).
messages.スキルの強化条件: 各攻撃スキルは「対象の速度が自分より3以上高い」「自分の速度: **Skill bonus conditions**: Each attack skill is strengthened if any of these holds: "the target is at least 3 faster than him," "his Speed is 1 or less," or "the target has Dazzle," and also gains +1 Coin Power at 6 or more combined Sinking and Burn on the target. S3 gains all-Unbreakable Coins and +3 Clash Power if the target has Dazzle. Coin Ⅲ deals +60% damage if the target (main body) is at 25% HP or less or has Dazzle. If the target has Dazzle, on hit it also deals Gloom damage equal to 80% of this Coin's final damage (60% at lower Uptie). After the attack, if the target dies or has 3 Dazzle, he gains 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn (once per turn).
messages.速度の扱い: 常時発動の「眩惑のランプ」により、速度の最小・最大値は外部効果で変: **Handling Speed**: Through the always-active Dazzling Lamp, his minimum and maximum Speed are not changed by external effects. When he would gain Haste, he gains 1 Clash Power Up instead (once per turn). In Focused Encounters, when selecting skills, he can redirect an enemy attack skill's target to himself regardless of Speed. Even though he is slow, he can draw enemy attacks to himself and take the Clash.
messages.バトルパッシブ「灯りのような眼」(憂鬱×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 眩惑のある: **Combat passive — Eyes Bright Like Lamps (2 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If an enemy has Dazzle, restores 5 SP at Combat Start (3 at lower Uptie). At Turn End, gives Guardians of the Forest to the ally earliest in team order (excluding himself).
messages.集中戦闘では1ターン目に守備でランプを8にし、次のターンにボスへ眩惑3を付ける。: In Focused Encounters, fill Lamp to 8 with his Defense skill on turn 1, then apply 3 Dazzle to the boss next turn. Attack with S3 and S2 while Dazzle lasts. Paired with allies who inflict Burn and Sinking, he meets both Dazzle's damage-taken increase and each skill's 6-or-more total condition. In regular battles, targets tend to die soon after being Dazzled, so it is better to build Lamp gradually and aim for the Speed condition through Bind. On the turn after Lamp hits maximum, 10 Aggro is added, making it easier to gather attacks (the effect text applies it to the "leftmost slot"). Make use of his durability to absorb them.
